newsitem.title: UK: Baltic Freight Index falls 58 on week.
newsitem.headline: Baltic Freight Index falls 58 on week.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index fell 16 to 1,310 points on Friday, a total of 58 lost on the week.
Further widespread falls in Panamax rates have been reported including Oinoussian Lion 71,170 dwt delivery prompt Gibraltar for a trip via US Gulf to Japan with Frapaco at $12,650 daily.
Others included Mitsubishi covering Nultrans tonnage for 54,000 tonnes heavy grain USGulf/Japan for September at $21.75 no combination.
In the East the Cargill vessel Paiute 70,293 dwt was fixed by Panocean delivery NoPac mid-Aug trip Taiwan with grain at $9,000 daily plus $140,000 bonus.
Caper rates were said by brokers to be little changed.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was 10 to 33 points down and turnover was 30 lots.
